# CANDIDATE: INTRADAY_SWING_LEVEL_DISCOVERY

**Filed:** 2026-06-29
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_trigger
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

Intraday swing highs and lows can be deterministically discovered each bar and added to levels_active without over-trading. This unblocks both detectors and any existing level_rejection/level_reclaim logic.

## Mechanism

1. Implement a swing-pivot scanner that appends fresh levels to ctx.levels_active each tick.
2. The scanner will identify local highs and lows over the last N RTH bars with a minimum prominence.
3. The scanner will be anchored to __file__-safe state (C9).
